title.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for an event's title.

held.description: The legend of the choice between an event held once and one that repeats every week.

once.description: The choice of an event held once.

weekly.description: The choice of an event that repeats every week.

date.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the date of an event held once.

day.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the day of the week a repeating event is held on.

weeks.description: The label of the field for which weeks of the month a repeating event is held in.

weeksHint.defaultMessage: Which of the month’s weeks, as 1, 3. Empty is every week.
weeksHint.description: The hint under the weeks field: how the weeks are written, and what an empty field means.

start.description: The label of the field, and the heading of the table column, for the time an event starts.

end.description: The label of the field for the time an event ends.

location.description: The label of the field for where an event is held.

locationHint.description: The hint under the location field: what an empty field means.

image.description: The label of the field for the address of an event's picture.

note.description: The label of the field for the few words shown under an event's title in a list.

noteHint.defaultMessage: A few words under its title in a list.
noteHint.description: The hint under the note field: where the note is shown.

body.description: The label of the field for the text of an event's own page.

bodyHint.description: The hint under the body field: how the body is written, and where it is shown.
